verified_facts.text: The hotel bills itself as the highest-altitude InterContinental hotel in the world.
verified_facts.excerpt: THE WORLD'S TALLEST ALTITUDE INTERCONTINENTAL HOTEL.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are designed in Tibetan style, with a digital entertainment system, a spacious bathroom and internet access.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms are designed with Tibetan style, and equipped with digital entertainment system, spacious bathroom and Internet access.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have in-room central oxygen and access to humidifiers to help guests stay comfortable at high altitude.
verified_facts.excerpt: In-room Central oxygen and access to humidifiers are supplied for guests to have comfortable in the high altitude environment

verified_facts.text: The lobby bar serves a Tibetan-style afternoon tea that blends British and Tibetan flavors, including highland barley Napoleons and highland barley tiramisu.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel's lobby bar has introduced a Tibetan-style afternoon tea that blends British and Tibetan flavors. Highland barley Napoleons and highland barley tiramisu are full of local characteristics.

verified_facts.text: Feast All Day Dining serves Western, Chinese, Tibetan and Asian dishes, with buffet and a la carte service.
verified_facts.excerpt: The restaurant serves Western, Chinese, Tibetan and Asian popular dishes, providing buffet and a la carte services

verified_facts.text: The Chief Concierge, a Golden Key member, guides guests to nearby attractions and suggests authentic Lhasa dining and experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Chief Concierge-"Golden key" will guide guests to nearby attractions and suggest authentic Lhasa dining and experiences.

verified_facts.text: The Potala Palace is about 8.1 kilometers (5 miles) from the hotel.
Jokhang Temple is about 6.6 kilometers (4.1 miles) from the hotel.
Lhasa Gonggar Airport is approximately 70 kilometers (43.5 miles) from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: approximately 43.5 miles away (70 kilometers) from the hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, InterContinental Lhasa Paradise does not have a pool.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has seven banquet halls of different sizes, the largest a 1,200-square-meter grand banquet hall that holds 1,000 people.
verified_facts.excerpt: 7 banquet halls of different sizes, with the 1,200 m² grand banquet hall capable of accommodating 1,000 people.

verified_facts.text: Children's activities are offered on site.
Parking is complimentary for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary parking is available at InterContinental Lhasa Paradise for hotel guests.
Yes, the InterContinental Lhasa Paradise offers free WiFi!
No, pets are not allowed at InterContinental Lhasa Paradise.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is at No.1 Jiangsu Avenue, Lhasa.
verified_facts.excerpt: No.1 Jiangsu Avenue Lhasa, TB 850000 Mainland China

verified_facts.text: Moonlight Lounge, the lobby lounge, is a place for afternoon tea or an evening cocktail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Moonlight Lounge is the place to enjoy an afternoon tea or a cocktail in the evening.
